words.meaning: a state of extreme joyful excitement
words.sentence1: The jubilancy in the crowded square was infectious as the autumn festival reached its peak. (The jubilancy in the crowded square was infectious as the autumn festival reached its peak.)
words.sentence2: A quiet jubilancy filled her heart when she finally gathered the ripe apples from her garden. (A quiet jubilancy filled her heart when she finally gathered the ripe apples from her garden.)

words.meaning: the quality of being cheerful and friendly
words.sentence1: Su jovialidad ilumino la reunion familiar durante la cena de accion de gracias. (His cheerfulness brightened the family gathering during the Thanksgiving dinner.)
words.sentence2: La jovialidad de los agricultores era evidente al celebrar el fin de la temporada. (The cheerfulness of the farmers was evident as they celebrated the end of the season.)

words.sentence1: Une grande allegresse s'empara du village au moment de ramasser les fruits murs. (A great joy seized the village at the time of gathering the ripe fruits.)
words.sentence2: Il partageait sa joie avec une telle allegresse que tout le monde sourit. (He shared his joy with such lively happiness that everyone smiled.)

words.meaning: a feeling or expression of great joy and triumph
words.sentence1: Groszartiger Jubel erfuellte das Tal bei der erfolgreichen Einbringung der reifen Fruechte. (Great jubilation filled the valley upon the successful gathering of the ripe fruits.)
words.sentence2: Der Jubel der Dorfbewohner ueber die reichliche Ernte war weithin zu hoeren. (The villagers' jubilation over the abundant harvest could be heard far and wide.)

words.meaning: blessing or a fortunate event that brings happiness
words.sentence1: Aki no minori wa watashitachi ni totte shukufuku no yō desu. (The autumn harvest feels like a blessing to us.)
words.sentence2: Minna de gochisō o tabete shukufuku oiwai o shimashita. (We ate a feast together and celebrated the blessing.)

words.sentence1: Unondata di esultanza accompagno la fine del raccolto nei campi dorati. (A wave of jubilation accompanied the end of the harvest in the golden fields.)
words.sentence2: L'esultanza della comunita fu visibile durante la festa della raccolta. (The community's jubilation was visible during the harvest festival.)

words.sentence1: Zai shouhuo de jijié, cunminmen dou chongmanle huanle. (During the harvest season, the villagers were full of joy.)
words.sentence2: zhege jierizhong de huanle rang shiren nanwang. (The joy during this holiday made people unforgettable.)

words.sentence1: Pungnyeoneul majeun maeuleneun hwanhuiga gadeukhaessda. (The village that welcomed the abundant harvest was full of intense joy.)
words.sentence2: geudeul eun chusuui gippeumeul hwanhuiro pyohanhaessda. (They expressed the joy of the autumn harvest with ecstasy.)

words.sentence1: Pka amnou cherom nouch knong srok srae pi phleung phlas. (The flowers of prosperity bloom in the rural village from the changing weather.)
words.sentence2: Kar cherom mouy nis ban nam mok nov suos-sdei ning amnou dol krom kruosa. (This blooming brought happiness and prosperity to the family group.)

words.meaning: to shout with joy or celebrate exuberantly
words.sentence1: Die boere begin jubel wanneer die ryp vrugte veilig ingesamel is. (The farmers begin to shout with joy when the ripe fruits are safely gathered.)
words.sentence2: Almal kon net jubel en dankie sê vir die wonderlike oes tyd. (Everyone could only rejoice and give thanks for the wonderful harvest time.)
